Name: MMMmayo
Author: AngelOfStars
Description:
[size=6][b][i][u]Oh my god it's in the game now-[/u][/i][/b]
[/size]









Have you ever been mad that you couldn't drink  all of the Mayo in Stardew Valley? Have you wanted to try all of those delicious types of Mayo, and not just choke down some inedible void sludge? Well HERE YOU GO! I know absolutely EVERYONE was dying to have this exist, so here it is, and may you enjoy. 

Note: This mod adds three new items that are "mayo" - it does not alter the actual mayo in any way. Also you can craft it with a kitchen so I made them not as pricey as actual mayo... 


E N J O Y
